author: agent
objective: Among populations of 36 OECD countries, is country-level population-weighted long-term PM2.5 associated with log COVID-19 case and death rates per total population at 60 and 80 days after the first confirmed national case?

scientific_invariants.research_question: Among populations of 36 OECD countries, is country-level population-weighted long-term PM2.5 associated with log COVID-19 case and death rates per total population at 60 and 80 days after the first confirmed national case?
scientific_invariants.target_outcome_and_population: National cumulative confirmed COVID-19 case rate and death rate per total population among the 36 OECD countries, each measured on epidemic day 60 and day 80 after the first confirmed national case.
scientific_invariants.principal_contrast: Per 1 ug/m3 higher population-weighted annual PM2.5 concentration in 2017; log-outcome coefficient exponentiated to a case/death-rate ratio.
scientific_invariants.broad_geography: 36 OECD member countries listed in article Methods section 2.1 (as of March 2020; excluding Colombia)

article_evidence.finding: Methods 2.1-2.2 defines 36 countries, WHO COVID outcomes, covariates, population-weighted PM2.5 in 2015-2017, and log linear regression at days 60 and 80.
Table 1 specifies the four 2017 PM2.5 concentration models and five adjustment variables.
